title: The long non-coding RNA landscape of endurance exercise training
comparison_or_design: The male gastrocnemius RNA-seq comparison at the final endurance-training endpoint and its matched reference.
time_scope: The 8-week training endpoint and its matched control collection.
excluded: Female rats, vastus lateralis and every other tissue, reference RNA/vial controls and other training durations
ATAC-seq, methylation, proteomics, cross-tissue analyses and lncRNA expression results
population_or_material: Male Fischer 344 rat gastrocnemius (SKM-GN/SKMGN) materials in the MoTrPAC-derived RNA-seq resource.
requested_items: Endurance training versus sedentary control and training/collection duration
